units.source_text: “银河？美极了。可并不是每晚都这样吧。多明朗啊。”

en.t: The Milky Way? It is so beautiful. But it is not like this every night, is it? How bright it is.
The two of them came running over.

units.source_text: 银河好像从他们的后面倾泻到前面。

en.t: The Milky Way seemed to pour from behind them toward the front.

units.source_text: 驹子的脸仿佛映在银河上。

en.t: Komako's face seemed to be reflected in the Milky Way.
